findings.issue: The breadcrumb trail ('Home / Books / Travel') features light-colored text on an off-white background (#F5F5F5), which falls significantly below the WCAG AA minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for body and navigation text.
findings.recommendation: Increase the contrast by changing the breadcrumb link and text colors to a darker grey (e.g., #4A4A4A or darker) to ensure legibility and accessibility compliance.

findings.location: Warning alert banner box at the top of the main content column
findings.issue: The body text inside the yellow warning banner ('Warning! This is a demo website for web scraping purposes...') uses a light brownish-yellow hue on a light yellow background, failing the 4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast threshold.
findings.recommendation: Darken the alert text color to a deep bronze/brown (e.g., #6C521F) or a dark charcoal grey to satisfy contrast guidelines.

findings.location: Book title link elements under star ratings
findings.issue: Product titles under the book cover thumbnails (e.g., 'Full Moon over Noah's ...' and 'See America: A Celebration ...') are aggressively truncated with ellipses, weakening the visual prominence of the primary product information.
findings.recommendation: Remove premature truncation and allow book titles to wrap to a maximum of two lines. Slightly increase the font size of the titles relative to secondary metadata like stock status.

findings.issue: The category list items in the left-hand navigation sidebar have extremely dense vertical spacing, reducing scannability and violating comfortable tap target sizes for mobile or touch devices.
findings.recommendation: Add vertical padding (minimum 8px to 12px) to each list item in the sidebar menu to increase the target area and overall breathing room.
